shorts.title: GTA 6: Change These 3 Settings First
shorts.description:
Motion blur starts at 3 in GTA 6; most guides say drop it to 0 or 1. Turn camera shake down, and run the HDR calibration before you play.
Which did you change first? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6 Has 55 Trophies: Full Breakdown
shorts.description:
GTA 6 has 55 trophies: 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver and 46 Bronze. No online trophies, and 1,000 Gamerscore on Xbox.
Going for the Platinum? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts
